observations: Photo 0 shows a red/white shock-absorber mountain bicycle with front suspension fork and knobby tyres.
Front wheel has a disc brake rotor visible near the fork.
Rear suspension is not clearly visible as a full dual-suspension setup in the single photo.
A gear system is visible (chainring/cassette area), but exact drivetrain model/speeds are not readable.

identity.kind: shock-absorber mountain bicycle (front suspension; disc brake; geared)

claims.evidence: No readable brand/model text on the bike in photo 0; seller text alone.
Photo 0 clearly shows front suspension, but rear dual suspension is not clearly shown/confirmed in the single photo.
Front disc brake appears visible in photo 0; rear disc brake is not clearly shown in the single photo.
Photo 0 shows a geared drivetrain area (chainring/cassette) consistent with a gear system.

risks.risk: Rear suspension may not be dual (could be hardtail), affecting value.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the rear triangle and shock/hinge area (side view showing whether there is a rear shock).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a front-suspension (hardtail) mountain bike.

risks.risk: Rear disc brake may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the rear wheel hub/rotor and a short video of braking while stationary.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed dual disc (assume only front disc).

risks.risk: Drivetrain condition (gears may skip, chain worn) not shown.
risks.proof: Ask for a video shifting through all gears while pedaling, plus a close-up of chain and cassette.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing basic service/possible wear.

risks.risk: Wheel alignment, tyre wear, and brake rotor condition not shown.
risks.proof: Ask for close-ups of both tyres tread, brake rotors (front and rear), and a straight-on shot of wheels for wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming tyres/brakes may need attention.

proof_requests: Send a clear rear-side photo showing whether there is a rear shock/hinge (to confirm dual suspension).
Send a clear photo of the rear disc brake rotor and caliper (to confirm dual disc).
Send a short video: pedal forward and shift through all gears (to confirm gear system works smoothly).
Send close-ups of chain + cassette and both brake rotors (front and rear) for wear/damage.
response.reason: From the single photo, the bike appears to be a geared mountain bicycle with front suspension and at least a front disc brake, but key value drivers (dual suspension and dual disc) are not clearly confirmed. Without those, a confident price pick from comparables isn’t reliable.
